| # Reprogramming through CAN {#reprogramming-through-can-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                         |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 In CB-ME, only one CAN channel will remain enabled for communication at a given time. All the other CAN channels will remain disabled.

- If a valid shared configuration data is present in the NVM:

  - only the channel updated in shared configuration will be enabled as per the NVM configuration values.

  - all other CAN channels will be disabled by CB-ME.

- If there is no valid shared configuration data present in the NVM (or virgin ECU):

 - only CAN2 will be initialized by default with baud rate of 250kBaud.

 - all other CAN channels will be disabled by CB-ME.
